name: ARTU: A Second-Order Autoregressive Reference Method for Solar Radiation Forecasting
description: Reference implementation and technical documentation for ARTU, a second-order autoregressive naive benchmark for solar irradiance forecasting, alongside four classical reference methods (Persistence, Climatology, CLIPER, Exponential Smoothing). Includes the K_alpha bilinear-interpolation lookup tables used by the ARTU second-order update.

referencePublication.name: Benchmarks for solar radiation time series forecasting
